riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you seek purpose and certainty through structured training, clear advancement, and comprehensive support, this career can provide a substantial professional life.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value lies in a complete career system. Flight and command officers hold core military roles with clear advancement, strong benefits, and transition support. The stronger the combination of flight, command, and instruction, the greater the prospects.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你追求「使命感和确定性」——训练有体系、晋升有通道、保障有托底，这行会给你一份有分量的职业人生。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「职业体系完整」：飞行和指挥军官在军中属于核心岗位，晋升通道清晰，保障待遇和退役安置完善；能飞、能指挥、能带教，综合素质越高越有前途。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

breadcrumb.label: Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, And Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people with genuine curiosity about Earth and the universe. Explaining the eye of a typhoon, plate drift, or deep-sea hydrothermal vents becomes especially rewarding when students respond with visible excitement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling feature is the scale of the subject. Research can cover typhoon tracks, plate movement, or ocean circulation, and teaching these topics can spark visible student interest. Field expeditions and training at sea offer experiences rarely found in other careers.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Investigative I

breadcrumb.label: 高校大气、地球、海洋和空间科学教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「对地球和宇宙真好奇」的人——站在讲台上讲台风眼、讲板块漂移、讲深海热泉，学生眼里的光，就是这份职业最好的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带感的是「研究对象的宏大」：你研究的可能是台风路径、板块运动或海洋环流，站在讲台上讲这些，学生眼里有光；野外考察和海上实习更是别的职业给不了的体验。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Computer hardware engineering is worth considering if you remain curious about circuits and accept high-stakes design judgments.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops persistence with physical reality. Engineers need semiconductor knowledge and patience through repeated prototype failures. It suits people who can concentrate for long periods, enjoy disassembling devices, and care deeply about circuits.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, hands-on implementation, and clear standards (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Computer hardware engineers有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，计算机硬件工程师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和物理较真」——既要懂半导体，也要忍受样机反复不亮的挫败。适合坐得住、爱拆东西、对电路有执念的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、动手实现、也重规范（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who can stay focused in a laboratory, solder boards, and insist on finding the truth. Every division on an oscilloscope waveform deserves attention.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest satisfaction comes from restoring a board that did not work. Seeing the waveform stabilize on an oscilloscope can feel better than any reward.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E

breadcrumb.label: 电气与电子工程技师与技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「坐得住实验室、焊得起板子、较得起真」的人——示波器上的每一格波形，都值得你多看两眼。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「把不工作的板子修活了」——示波器上波形拉直的那一刻，比什么奖励都痛快。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most tangible reward is visible craftsmanship. When equipment you assembled starts running at a customer's site, the confidence of knowing 'I built that' can matter as much as piece-rate pay.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying part of this work is watching skilled hands create something useful. When a completed control cabinet passes its power-on test and the indicator lights come on, the achievement combines every correctly soldered wire and secured panel.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最踏实的回报是「手艺看得见」：你装的设备在客户现场跑起来，那种「这是我装出来的」的底气，是计件工资之外最实在的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「看着自己的手活变成能用的东西」：一台控制柜装完通电测试，指示灯亮起来的那一刻，跟焊好一条线、锁好一块面板的成就感是叠起来的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who find meaning in caring for others. You do not need dramatic achievements; caring well for one person's daily life is enough.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most meaningful part of this work is tangibly making someone's day better. When an older adult confined to bed looks and feels better because of your attentive care, the feeling of being needed is real.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「能从照顾别人里获得意义」的人——你不需要轰轰烈烈，把一个人的日常照顾好就够了。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意义的地方，是你能真切地让一个人的日子好过一点：一个长期卧床的老人，因为你护理得细心，气色好了、心情好了，这种被需要的感觉很真实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The rarest quality of this work is reality. Every emergency call involves a specific person, and every act of help is tangible. Protecting a street's peace provides the occupation's core reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The weight of this work comes from immediate feedback in the real world. Every emergency call and mediated dispute involves real people and lives. Helping someone resolve a crisis and restoring order to a street creates a sense of protection difficult to experience in office work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Realistic R + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最难得的是「真实感」：每一通报警电话背后都是一个具体的人，你能帮到的每一件事都实实在在。守护一条街的安宁，这种意义感是这份职业最核心的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有分量的是「真实世界的即时反馈」：你处理的每一起报警、每一次纠纷调解，都是真实的人和生活。能帮一个人解决困境、让一条街恢复秩序，那种「我在守护」的意义感，是坐办公室的人很难体会的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 现实型 R + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who are meticulous during normal operations and composed during incidents. Every detail in hazard investigations and drills builds confidence for the day a real incident occurs. When a drill becomes a real response and concludes safely, the sense of professional value is exceptional.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding moment is when a drill becomes reality. Emergency plans seem like paper during normal operations, but when a real incident occurs and the process evacuates people safely, you understand the value of every detail you monitored.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「平时越细、出事越稳」的人——你在隐患排查和演练上的每一分较真，都在为「真出事那天」攒底气；当演练真的变成实战并顺利收场，那种职业价值感是别的岗位给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「演练变实战的那天」——预案平时看着是纸，真出事时一套流程跑下来把人安全撤出，你才知道自己平时盯的那些细节值多少钱。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine resourcefulness, a good memory, and a willingness to care for others. The itinerary must flow, customers must feel secure, and every detail matters.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops coordination and empathy. You must understand destinations, calculate budgets accurately, and recognize whether customers value convenience or sophistication. It suits resourceful people with good memories who enjoy caring for others and turning plans into memories.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers leading, practical work, and helping others (Enterprising E + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱折腾 + 记性好 + 愿意为人操心」凑一块的人——行程要顺，客要安，心要细。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「统筹与共情」——既要懂目的地、算得清预算，也要读得懂客人要的是省心还是讲究。适合爱折腾、记性好、又愿意为人操心的人，也享受把计划变成回忆。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好主导、务实、也助人（企业 E + 现实 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who enjoy using both their hands and minds. They must apply weatherstripping skillfully and interpret thermal images, so every project has technical depth.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The tangible appeal is that every project shows results. Before a retrofit, homeowners complain about drafts; afterward, window frames feel noticeably warmer and electricity bills decline. This immediate feedback is satisfying and suits dexterous people who enjoy field work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「动手 + 动脑」的人——既要贴得了密封条，也要看得懂热成像图，每单都有技术含量。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的实在感在于「每一单都看得见效果」：改造前户主抱怨窗户透风，改造后摸摸窗框明显不凉了，电费单也降了——这种即时反馈很让人满足。适合手巧、爱跑外勤的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Sales Representatives, Wholesale And Manufacturing, Except Technical And Scientific Products

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who enjoy working with others and getting things done. Every long-term customer you win adds stable collections and referral sources. When customers treat you as one of their own, sales becomes a lasting business.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most grounded reward in this occupation is watching customer trust compound. A client you have served for three to five years calls you first when purchasing problems arise. When your solution saves money, they refer peers. This is not an overnight-rich career, but as relationships accumulate, income compounds.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Artistic A + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 批发与制造业销售代表（不含技术与科学产品）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢跟人打交道、把事做成」的人——你每签下一个长期客户，就多一份稳定回款和转介绍来源；客户把你当「自己人」，这行就干成了长期生意。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「客户的信任越攒越厚」：合作三五年的老客户，采购遇到问题第一个打电话给你；你推荐的方案帮客户省了钱，他会介绍同行给你。这行没有一夜暴富，但客户积累起来，收入是复利的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 艺术型 A + 事务型 C
